title: San Francisco licensees in the three health boards' files
question: How many San Francisco licences do the State files hold, and what can they not show?
finding: Checked; the files give a count, not a test. By address of record, the Medical Board file holds 8,201 current San Francisco physician licences and 484 medical-group name permits (155 lapsed). None of the three files has a discipline, probation or accusation field, and none lists revoked, surrendered or cancelled licences, so a check of discipline needs the Medical Board's bulk file, which was not obtained. No licensee or permit in any of the three files gives the San José apartment address of the 62 new billing companies in the case 'one-apartment-62-billing-numbers'.
how: Rows of each public information file whose city is San Francisco, counted by licence type and status. Fictitious name permits are the names under which a medical corporation or group practises.
limits: Address of record is where the board sends mail; a clinician can live or practise elsewhere. Lapsed licences include people who retired or moved away.

sources.t: California Department of Consumer Affairs, Medical Board of California public information file, updated 9 November 2026
